The ConnectRPC service clients are created in `/bench/repo/web/src/connect.ts`. This file uses the `createClient` function from the `@connectrpc/connect` package to instantiate all the service clients (lines 192-203), including:
- `instanceServiceClient`
- `authServiceClient`
- `userServiceClient`
- `memoServiceClient`
- `attachmentServiceClient`
- `aiServiceClient`
- `shortcutServiceClient`
- `identityProviderServiceClient`
